I have farmed this small plot in Nsanje for many years, and I know what my land can do. I do not have money for expensive chemical fertilizers or shop-bought seeds, so I will plant the sorghum seed I saved from last year's harvest and put some manure from my goats onto the soil. The rains will come when God sends them, because I have no pump or river water to irrigate, and I see no need to spray chemicals on a crop that has always grown well enough without them. My children and grandchildren will help me prepare, weed, and harvest the field, as we have always done together.
